# @postmanlabs/aiei-engine

> AIEI measures AI-assisted engineering effectiveness from connected tools (GitHub, Postman, observability, cost, security signals).
> AIEI is not a score for whether your public documentation site is agent-ready. See THESIS.md for what AIEI is and is not.

## Start here

- Thesis: ../THESIS.md
- README: ../README.md
- OpenAPI (HTTP contract): openapi.yaml
- Changelog: ../CHANGELOG.md

## What AIEI measures

- Q (Quality): defect rate of AI-assisted code vs baseline, test pass, rework, plus runtime contract signals
- L (Lead Time): cycle time delta with optional deploy frequency bonus
- R (Reliability): change failure rate, SLO attainment, contract catch rate, uptime, workflow adaptability
- C (Cost Efficiency): labor savings vs AI tooling spend, normalized to target ROI
- S (Security): supplemental, multiplicative across spec security, dependabot, code scanning, secret scanning

Run `aiei formula` for the current math. Every formula, constant, and weight profile is documented in ../SCORING.md and ../SIGNALS.md.

## Pilot path

- Three commands: `aiei init`, `aiei validate`, `aiei score --format html`
- Pilot runbook: ../docs/PILOT_RUNBOOK.md
- Connector access guidance: ../CONNECTOR_SCOPES.md
- Connector registry: ../CONNECTORS.md

## Agent and MCP usage

- MCP debugging and safe mode: ../docs/MCP_DEBUGGING.md
- MCP package: ../mcp-server
- Agent-native CLI design: ../cli/AGENT_NATIVE_CLI_SPEC.md

## Assessment JSON (implementers)

- CompositeResult: openapi.yaml components/schemas/CompositeResult (includes runGuidance, axMapping, epistemicSummary)
- Schema constant: src/types.ts (SCHEMA_VERSION)
- Migration notes between versions: ../MIGRATION.md

## What AIEI is not

- Not a documentation site agent-readiness scorer
- Not a replacement for agent gateways, MCP servers, or workflow orchestration platforms
- Not a media pipeline, video QoE, or client-side performance tool

See THESIS.md for the full positioning.
